context: 1.10 Conjectures and Open Problems We conjecture the following. ▶ Conjecture 1.16. The hitting time robustness is Ω(1/∆), where ∆ denotes the diameter. Since ∆ = O(tmix ), this would improve Theorem 1.10. Theorem 1.11 establishes this conjecture for trees, which is tight for the path and cycle. ▶ Conjecture 1.17. For all graphs, the cover time robustness is the hitting time robustness, up to a constant factor.
